Nursing with three years research experience OR PG in relevant field. Well versed with Punjabi & English-Speaking, Reading & Writing. Two years experience in relevant subject/field.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Bathinda Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support-III (Qualitative Research): Graduate in Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Clinical research/B.Sc. Nursing with three years research experience OR PG in relevant field. Well versed with Punjabi & English-Speaking, Reading & Writing. Project Technical Support-III (Statistician +IT domain experience): Graduate in statistics/biostatistics from recognized university OR First class four years graduate degree in relevant subject (engineering/IT/CS). 3 years experience. Project Technical Support-III (Project manager/assistant coordinator): Graduate in any stream with three-year experience or PG in relevant subject/field OR Four years graduate degree in relevant subject (engineering/IT/CS). Well versed with Punjabi & English- Speaking, Reading & Writing. Project Technical Support - I: 10th + Diploma or 12th. Good command on Punjabi & English - Speaking, Reading & Writing. Two years experience in relevant subject/field.

content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications received Interview / Written exam or both at Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, Medical College, AIIMS, Bathinda

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Bathinda Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Bathinda to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bathinda (AIIMS Bathinda) for filling up research project positions in Punjab.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under AIIMS Bathinda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for Project Technical Support posts across various specializations in the research department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bathinda Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application via the Google form is 12-10-2026 up to 12:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for AIIMS Bathinda?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 13-10-2026 at the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, Medical College, AIIMS, Bathinda.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support-III posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Technical Support-III positions will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,800/- inclusive of HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum qualification required for Project Technical Support - I?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Project Technical Support - I require 10th + Diploma or 12th qualification with two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Project Technical Support-III candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying to Project Technical Support-III posts is up to 35 years.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Bathinda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to these project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q9. What mode of application is accepted for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the provided Google form link along with self-attested scanned copies of supporting documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview or written exam will take place at the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, Medical College, AIIMS, Bathinda.
